description: This file defines the JobsFragment class, an Android Fragment that manages a RecyclerView displaying a list of Job objects. It reads job data from internal storage, parses the JSON content, creates Job instances, and populates the RecyclerView with this data.

classes.name: JobsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of jobs in a RecyclerView, loading data from storage and parsing JSON.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A model class representing a job entry. (Assumed to be defined elsewhere in the project.)

classes.name: JobsAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass for binding Job objects to the RecyclerView. (Assumed to be defined elsewhere.)

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of JobsFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes the RecyclerView, and loads job data.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Reads JSON data from internal storage, parses it into Job objects, and populates the RecyclerView.

calls: new Job(jobId, status, parcelType, parcelSize, parcelWeight, parcelTrackingID)
